reason: I already know roughly where the leakage is; a lot of it is deliberate goodwill with clients I've had for fifteen years. A report telling me I could bill more doesn't help when the hard part is having that conversation, and I'd rather not have it.
objection: Potential leakage isn't money in the bank. Every line on that report means me picking up the phone to a long-standing client and asking for more, and I'm not going to risk those relationships over a few hundred quid here and there.
would_change_my_mind: If it showed big, clear-cut cases like unbilled licences we're paying for out of our own pocket, where the client couldn't reasonably argue, and nothing that touches the small favours I do on purpose.
